campaign.commit_subject: feat(subject): a clock the arms share, and a fork that stops guessing what to carry

phi.note: cross-fitted over 5 folds; the in-sample minimum over 511 cuts is -0.0214

criteria.requires: every domain reaches every other one through interventional edges
criteria.bar: one component covering all domains

criteria.requires: no single domain's removal disconnects the rest
every domain lies on at least two cross-domain directed cycles
criteria.bar: >= 2 each

criteria.requires: influence leaves each domain and returns through at least two others
criteria.bar: cycle length >= 3

criteria.requires: the cheapest bipartition still costs held-out prediction
irreducibility exceeds every null architecture and matched surrogate
criteria.bar: above all nulls

criteria.requires: the state is differentiated and still integrated: many effective dimensions, none dominant, and not a bag of independent variables
criteria.bar: d_eff >= 3, top share < 0.5, ratio < 0.4

detail.why_the_inequality_runs_this_way: frozen_slow 0.736, one_way 0.481, star 0.313, hub 0.195, prompt_only 0.158, aura 0.096, recurrent_reference 0.070 — the bar as written is passed by the least mind-like systems and failed by the most integrated, so it is applied as an upper bound with a floor and a dominance limit beneath it

criteria.requires: effective dimension is far above the one-dimensional floor
criteria.bar: d_eff >= 3 and no component above half the variance

criteria.requires: the previous internal state predicts the next beyond the environment
criteria.bar: > 0, and above the shuffled-state control

criteria.requires: no variable outside K predicts K's future better than K does
criteria.bar: no improvement on K beyond what a shuffled periphery gives

criteria.requires: a local displacement reaches most of the core
the response is structured, not local and not a broadcast
criteria.bar: a response that reached somewhere, above the 99th percentile of matched nulls

criteria.requires: domains carry information jointly that neither carries alone
criteria.bar: >= 0.1 and above its shifted null

criteria.requires: the state settles into regimes and still moves between them
criteria.bar: more than one regime, entropy strictly between zero and its ceiling

criteria.requires: workspace content reaches at least three heterogeneous consumers
a consumer of the workspace later changes the workspace again
criteria.bar: at least one G -> X -> G path

criteria.requires: changing the self-model changes deliberation or behaviour
criteria.bar: above the same-arm floor

criteria.requires: the same world state updates the self differently when she caused it
criteria.bar: above the same-arm floor

criteria.requires: fast cognition changes the slow developmental state
criteria.bar: at least one edge from a fast domain into a slow one

criteria.requires: the slow developmental state changes later fast cognition
criteria.bar: at least one edge from a slow domain into a fast one

criteria.requires: the graph holds across ordinary conditions, not only one workload
criteria.bar: strongly connected in at least three conditions

criteria.requires: cutting the cheapest partition degrades the measures it should
criteria.bar: irreducibility, complexity and synergy all fall

criteria.requires: restoring the cut restores them
criteria.bar: a deficit first, then the measures return towards the intact values

criteria.requires: the whole battery separates the system from every matched null
criteria.bar: no null passes the conjunction
